name: Bullard Marks Veterinary Medical Center
description: Bullard Marks Veterinary Medical Center provides veterinary care for dogs in Bishop, CA. Info sourced from OpenStreetMap public map data — call ahead to confirm hours and services.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: The staff is wonderful, kind and extremely knowledgeable. Dr. Brar is awesome. I was very nervous and worried about my pup. He gave such good care and explained everything to me as he examined and diagnosed. Very caring and thorough. Put me at ease and took excellent care of my pup. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dr. Brarr took very good care of my dog Luna when she had a tummy ache. He was very thorough with her check up to make sure he did not miss anything. Quickly got her in for an appointment. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a vet that is going to take care of your pet like family!

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I am very pleased with Bullard Marks Vet so far. I noticed an issue with my elderly cat and even though this wasn’t “an emergency” per se, I was surprised at how quickly they got us in. I was also very impressed that all the office staff and assistants were very knowledgeable, and they worked with the Dr. as an efficient team. The office is clean, comfortable and modern. The vet was no nonsense but accommodating to both me and my kitty.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Staff is extremely friendly and works with you as often as possible. Considerate when appropriate. I’ve never seen them treat any animal (or their humans) with anything but care. The staff are quick and professional. And from my experience the prices aren’t bad at all, considering the quality. I have four dogs of various sizes and ages. We have been there for emergencies and for vaccine updates. I won’t take them anywhere else.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I took a ferral kitten in to be seen. He was about 2 – 3 weeks old. His eyes were matted shut and he wasn’t eating. The staff were very gentle with him. The doctor cleaned him up and gave clear instructions on what we needed to do to help him get better. 1 week later he is eating, running around, playful and his eyes are open. He is acting like a normal healthy kitten. Thank you. I know he would not have survived.
